versos.hebraico: הֵ֥ן לְצֶ֖דֶק יִמְלָךְ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּלְשָׂרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפָּ֥ט יָשֹֽׂרוּ׃

controles.web: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.
controles.kjv: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
controles.livre: Eis que um rei reinará com justiça, e príncipes governarão conforme o juízo.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה־אִ֥ישׁ כְּמַֽחֲבֵא־ר֖וּחַ וְסֵ֣תֶר זָ֑רֶם כְּפַלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם בְּצָי֔וֹן כְּצֵ֥ל סֶֽלַע־כָּבֵ֖ד בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עֲיֵפָֽה׃

controles.web: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.
controles.kjv: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
controles.livre: E cada homem será como um abrigo contra o vento, e refúgio contra a tempestade; como ribeiros de águas em lugares secos, como a sombra de uma grande rocha num lugar deserto.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁעֶ֖ינָה עֵינֵ֣י רֹאִ֑ים וְאָזְנֵ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה׃

controles.web: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
controles.kjv: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
controles.livre: E os olhos dos que vem não se ofuscarão; e os ouvidos dos que ouvem estarão atentos.

versos.hebraico: וּלְבַ֥ב נִמְהָרִ֖ים יָבִ֣ין לָדָ֑עַת וּלְשׁ֣וֹן עִלְּגִ֔ים תְּמַהֵ֖ר לְדַבֵּ֥ר צָחֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.
controles.kjv: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
controles.livre: E o coração dos imprudentes entenderá o conhecimento, e a língua dos gagos estará pronta para falar com clareza.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד לְנָבָ֖ל נָדִ֑יב וּלְכִילַ֕י לֹ֥א יֵֽאָמֵ֖ר שֽׁוֹעַ׃

controles.web: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.
controles.kjv: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
controles.livre: Nunca mais o tolo será chamado de nobre, nem o avarento de generoso;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י נָבָל֙ נְבָלָ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְלִבּ֖וֹ יַעֲשֶׂה־אָ֑וֶן לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חֹ֗נֶף וּלְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל־יְהוָה֙ תּוֹעָ֔ה לְהָרִיק֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָעֵ֔ב וּמַשְׁקֶ֥ה צָמֵ֖א יַחְסִֽיר׃

controles.web: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, To make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
controles.kjv: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
controles.livre: Pois o tolo fala tolices, e seu coração opera maldade, para praticar perversidade e falar enganos contra o SENHOR, para deixar vazia a alma do faminto, e fazer com que o sedento não tenha o que beber.

versos.hebraico: וְכֵלַ֖י כֵּלָ֣יו רָעִ֑ים ה֚וּא זִמּ֣וֹת יָעָ֔ץ לְחַבֵּ֤ל ענוים בְּאִמְרֵי־שֶׁ֔קֶר וּבְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶבְי֖וֹן מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
controles.kjv: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
controles.livre: Os instrumentos do avarento são maléficos; ele trama planos malignos para destruir aos aflitos com palavras falsas, mesmo quando o pobre fala com justiça.

versos.hebraico: וְנָדִ֖יב נְדִיב֣וֹת יָעָ֑ץ וְה֖וּא עַל־נְדִיב֥וֹת יָקֽוּם׃פ

controles.web: But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
controles.kjv: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
controles.livre: Mas o nobre pensa em coisas nobres, e em coisas nobres ele permanece.

versos.hebraico: נָשִׁים֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת קֹ֖מְנָה שְׁמַ֣עְנָה קוֹלִ֑י בָּנוֹת֙ בֹּֽטח֔וֹת הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!
controles.kjv: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
controles.livre: Levantai-vos, mulheres que estais em repouso, e ouvi a minha voz; ó filhas, que estais tão confiantes, dai ouvidos às minhas palavras:

versos.hebraico: יָמִים֙ עַל־שָׁנָ֔ה תִּרְגַּ֖זְנָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת כִּ֚י כָּלָ֣ה בָצִ֔יר אֹ֖סֶף בְּלִ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage shall fail. The harvest won’t come.
controles.kjv: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
controles.livre: Daqui a um ano e alguns dias, sereis perturbadas, vós, que estais tão confiantes; porque a produção de uvas não terá sucesso, e a colheita não virá.

versos.hebraico: חִרְדוּ֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת רְגָ֖זָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת פְּשֹׁ֣טָֽה וְעֹ֔רָה וַחֲג֖וֹרָה עַל־חֲלָצָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.
controles.kjv: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
controles.livre: Tremei vós que estais em repouso, e sede perturbadas, vós que estais tão confiantes; despi-vos, e ficai nuas, e vesti vossos lombos com roupa de saco .

versos.hebraico: עַל־שָׁדַ֖יִם סֹֽפְדִ֑ים עַל־שְׂדֵי־חֶ֕מֶד עַל־גֶּ֖פֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
controles.kjv: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
controles.livre: Lamentai-vos batendo em vossos peitos por causa dos campos agradáveis e das vides frutíferas;

versos.hebraico: עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת עַמִּ֔י ק֥וֹץ שָׁמִ֖יר תַּֽעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֚י עַל־כָּל־בָּתֵּ֣י מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָֽה׃

controles.web: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.
controles.kjv: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
controles.livre: Por causa da terra do meu povo, na qual espinhos e cardos crescerão; e por causa das casas de alegria na cidade alegre.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַרְמ֣וֹן נֻטָּ֔שׁ הֲמ֥וֹן עִ֖יר עֻזָּ֑ב עֹ֣פֶל וָבַ֜חַן הָיָ֨ה בְעַ֤ד מְעָרוֹת֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ פְּרָאִ֖ים מִרְעֵ֥ה עֲדָרִֽים׃

controles.web: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;
controles.kjv: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
controles.livre: Pois o palácio será abandonado, a cidade ruidosa ficará deserta; a colina  e as torres de guarda serão esvaziadas para sempre, para alegria dos jumentos selvagens, e servirão de pasto para o gado;

versos.hebraico: עַד־יֵ֨עָרֶ֥ה עָלֵ֛ינוּ ר֖וּחַ מִמָּר֑וֹם וְהָיָ֤ה מִדְבָּר֙ לַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וכרמל לַיַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: Until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.
controles.kjv: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
controles.livre: Até que seja derramado sobre nós o Espírito do alto; então o deserto se tornará um lugar fértil, e o lugar fértil será considerado uma floresta.

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁכַ֥ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בַּכַּרְמֶ֥ל תֵּשֵֽׁב׃

controles.web: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.
controles.kjv: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
controles.livre: E o juízo habitará no deserto, e a justiça morará no campo fértil.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַצְּדָקָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָבֶ֖טַח עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
controles.kjv: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
controles.livre: E a consequência da justiça será paz; e o produto da justiça, repouso e segurança para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְיָשַׁ֥ב עַמִּ֖י בִּנְוֵ֣ה שָׁל֑וֹם וּֽבְמִשְׁכְּנוֹת֙ מִבְטַחִ֔ים וּבִמְנוּחֹ֖ת שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
controles.kjv: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
controles.livre: E meu povo habitará na morada da paz, em moradias bem seguras, em tranquilos lugares de descanso.

versos.hebraico: וּבָרַ֖ד בְּרֶ֣דֶת הַיָּ֑עַר וּבַשִּׁפְלָ֖ה תִּשְׁפַּ֥ל הָעִֽיר׃

controles.web: Though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.
controles.kjv: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
controles.livre: (Granizo, porém, derrubará a floresta, e a cidade será abatida).

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁרֵיכֶ֕ם זֹרְעֵ֖י עַל־כָּל־מָ֑יִם מְשַׁלְּחֵ֥י רֶֽגֶל־הַשּׁ֖וֹר וְהַחֲמֽוֹר׃ס

controles.web: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
controles.kjv: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurados sois vós, os que semeais sobre todas as águas; e deixais livres os pés do boi e do jumento.
